manifest_preview.benchmark: pooled-context adaptation; dev contexts included only under train_plus_validation
manifest_preview.passage_granularity: one original context entry; no chunking
manifest_preview.embedding_text_rule: original title + LF + space.join(original ordered sentences)
manifest_preview.canonicalization: NFC then Unicode whitespace split/join independently on complete title and joined passage; canonical JSON [title,text]
manifest_preview.document_id_algorithm: 2wiki-v1: + SHA256(UTF8 canonical JSON [title,text]); compare canonical bytes on hash match, abort collisions
manifest_preview.raw_variant_algorithm: variant-v1: + SHA256(UTF8 canonical JSON [original title,original sentence list])
manifest_preview.representative_rule: first occurrence in fixed train/dev order, original row order and context position; variants preserve every alternative
manifest_preview.serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, compact separators, LF; documents/variants sorted by ID; refs by doc_id,split,question_id,position
manifest_preview.data_quality_policy: all context entries included regardless of QA/evidence flags; no gold/support-based selection

cross_split_overlap.definition: shared = canonical documents appearing in >1 included split; entry count includes all occurrences

dry_run.runtime_estimate_note: Export estimate assumes 20 MiB/s sequential throughput; sorted SQLite scan overhead and antivirus may add time.
